name: Document Trail
rules: Start a=7, b=11, m=0. Turn t has t² substeps; for j=1..t² update simultaneously with old state: a=(a²+3b+j+m) mod 1009 and b=(b²+5a+t+j+m) mod 1013. After the turn, score=(a+31b) mod 1009; carry both registers and m forward. At checkpoints, retrieve the named document and set m from the quoted field exactly as instructed before continuing.

checkpoints.instruction: Quote opening hours and set m to the first integer.
Quote the first numeric field, or the first field if none.
Quote the next field and set m to its character count mod 97.
Quote the remaining text and set m to its character count mod 97.
